policies.title: Shipping, returns and privacy
policies.intro: Plain-language answers about delivery, cancellations, warranty help and the data we store. If something is not covered here, contact the store and we will look at your order.
policies.shippingIntro: Delivery charges are calculated from the store settings at checkout. Orders above the free-shipping threshold shown in the cart and checkout pay no delivery fee.
policies.shipping1: Available delivery methods and fees are shown before you confirm an order.
policies.shipping2: Once an order is shipped, its carrier and tracking number appear on the order page.
policies.shipping3: Order status moves through Pending, Confirmed, Processing, Shipped and Delivered.
policies.returnsIntro: You can cancel an order from your account while it is still Pending or Confirmed. Cancelling releases the reserved stock and any coupon you used.
policies.returns1: Orders that are already Processing, Shipped or Delivered cannot be cancelled online.
policies.returns2: For a delivered order, contact support with the order number and we will review the case.
policies.returns3: Paid orders are not cancelled automatically; the store team handles the payment side.
policies.paymentsIntro: Checkout offers the payment methods the store has enabled. Today that means:
policies.payments1: Cash on delivery — pay when the order arrives.
policies.payments2: Bank transfer — when enabled by the store, the transfer details appear on the order page and a team member confirms the payment manually.
policies.paymentsNote: Card payments are not enabled on this store. Payment status is always visible on your order.
policies.warrantyIntro: Warranty terms depend on the product and its manufacturer. Keep your order number ready and contact support — we will confirm the applicable coverage and the next step for your device.
policies.warranty1: Product pages list specifications and available variants; warranty is not altered by the store.
policies.warranty2: Physical damage and water damage are handled according to the manufacturer’s policy.
policies.privacyIntro: We keep the information needed to run your account and orders:
policies.privacy1: Account details: name, email, phone number, hashed password and the last sign-in device/browser description (managed by ASP.NET Core Identity).
policies.privacy2: Delivery addresses you save, plus the address snapshot attached to each order.
policies.privacy3: Order, payment and review history, and administrative audit records.
policies.privacy4: Technical cookies for sign-in, cart and session state. No third-party analytics or ad trackers are used.
policies.privacyNote: To correct or remove your account data, contact the store. Order records may be retained where required for accounting and dispute handling.
